notes: Researched from public maac.com pages (Resident Services incl. its FAQ answers, FAQs hub) and the RentCafe confirmation help article; MAA's Resident Login is the RentCafe portal maac.securecafe.com (bot wall, sign-in labels not observed). sources.title: How do I know if my payment is confirmed? (RentCafe)

pay_online.note: Pay rent online through the Resident Login portal.

help.title: Paying rent online
paragraphs: Yes, MAA residents can pay rent online: choose Resident Login in the main navigation and sign in. The same portal lets you submit and track service requests, see online deals and follow community news. Features can vary by community.

help.title: Service requests
paragraphs: After signing in through Resident Login you can submit service requests and send other messages to your community managers. MAA Resident Services also offers 24/7 on-call support.

help.title: Confirming your payment
paragraphs: Right after you pay, a confirmation screen shows the payment is processing and lets you download a receipt. You can also open Monthly Charges in the portal: a processed payment shows in your balance. If neither shows the payment, it probably failed; failed payments are not retried, so submit a new one-time payment.

help.title: Contact MAA
paragraphs: For assistance call 866-620-1130 or use the Contact Us page. Corporate headquarters: 6815 Poplar Avenue, Suite 500, Germantown, TN 38138.

extra.intent: Using the MAA help pages, find MAA's assistance phone number. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
